newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bullish Kvaerner trade lifts Norway stocks.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Kvaerner trade lifts Norway stocks.

text.p: Offshore engineering and shipbuilding group Kvaerner's stock rose on the Oslo Bourse on Thursday to help lift the Total index by 0.36 percent.
After a weak opening, The Total index closed at 922.34 points in trade worth a healthy 724 million crowns, including 105 million in Kvaerner A and B class shares.
"The market went up on rumours that Kvaerner Masa Yards would win a contract with Royal Caribbean Cruises to build two cruise ships at a total value of $1 billion," one dealer said.
Kvaerner A shares rose 3.17 percent to 260 crowns and the B share was up 4.15 percent at 238.50 crowns.

Industrial giant Norsk Hydro, which has a 20 percent weighting on the Total Index, rose 0.31 percent to 319.50 crowns to help set the tone. Hydro was the second most traded share after Kvaerner at 53 million crowns.
